# Arav Goswami

Carnegie Mellon University

About

I’m interested in computer architecture—how the software we write meets the hardware that runs it. I like thinking about dataflow, systems, and what happens under the hood.

I’m also into hands-on tinkering with sensors and motors. Outside the workbench, I like watching tennis and football, and there’s a dog in my life.

Currently exploring

FPGA compute and signal processing, practical software tools, and the building blocks behind computer systems.
